gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.007033 40.745807)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
tri_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_TRI(rast, 1) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(t.rast, 1, o.pt) AS tri_value
FROM tri_rast t, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.007033, 40.745807), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
clipped_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             r.rast,
             true,
             ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)::geometry, 1000) -- buffer 1km to capture terrain around the point
           ) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r,
       poi_geom p
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
        ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)::geometry,
        r.rast
      )
),
ruggedness_index AS (
  SELECT ST_RuggednessIndex(rast, 1) AS ruggedness_index
  FROM clipped_raster
)
SELECT ruggedness_index
FROM ruggedness_index;
